entities.name: Ghired
entities.description: Former Selesnya Conclave shaman who aligned with the Gruul Clans and left Ravnica for Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Untamed wilderness plane Ghired traveled to.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths Ghired used to travel to Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Ghired shifted his allegiance to the Gruul after witnessing the manifestation of the Boar-God Ilharg during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Ghired shifted his allegiance after witnessing the awe-inspiring manifestation of the Boar - God Ilharg , during the War of the Spark

events.summary: Ghired traveled through the Omenpaths to Thunder Junction.
events.quote: Ghired traveled through the Omenpaths to Thunder Junction to experience its untamed wilderness.

relations.quote: a former shaman of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica who later aligned with the Gruul Clans
